tier1.text: The rough endoplasmic reticulum (rough ER) makes and modifies proteins that go to the cell membrane or leave the cell. The rough ER is part of the endoplasmic reticulum, a system of channels joined to the membrane around the nucleus. Ribosomes, the cell parts that build proteins, dot the rough ER and give it a bumpy look. Cells that release proteins, such as liver cells, have a lot of rough ER.
